story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Recognize inbound Eligibility, Assessment, and Maintenance dates for transaction effective date selection
Use Eligibility Date for new enrollment before eligibility span begins regardless of Assessment Date
Use Assessment Date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes
Use Assessment Date and preserve relevant field values when only Assessment Date changes
Use Eligibility Date for relevant field changes received before eligibility begins when Assessment Date is unchanged
Use Maintenance Date only for relevant field changes after eligibility begins when Assessment Date is unchanged
Regression guardrail for prohibited Maintenance Date usage outside allowed scenarios
